frames.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Turn the most recent SINGLE front-facing dragon into ONE airborne DESCENDING flight pose. Keep exactly the same dragon identity, scale, centered position, transparent square canvas, and left-only lighting. Lower its bat wings to a broad shallow downstroke, tips remaining completely within the canvas with generous empty margin; bend the knees and tuck the hooked talons up toward its body, as it descends toward the tower before extending its feet. Face directly toward camera, no turn, no tilt, no side profile. Keep the head, torso and horns at their original coordinates. The wing membranes should show strong fine monochrome stipple on SCREEN LEFT; screen-right wing, right cheek and right flank remain almost black. Mostly opaque black body, no white chest or glowing eyes. Genuine transparency outside the silhouette and in wing gaps; opaque black remains inside the dragon. One complete isolated dragon, no sheet or adjacent poses, no text, no external shadow, no haze or detached dots. At least 80px fully transparent margin at each edge, all wing tips and talons fully contained.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit ONLY the wing pose of the most recent SINGLE half-folded dragon image into a BRAKING / TOUCHDOWN pose. EXACT same front-facing dragon, exact head/body/feet positions and proportions, identical square canvas and transparent background. Lift both wings high and outward into a broad raised V, with leathery membranes fanned out as it brakes to land. Wing joints near x360,y350 and x900,y350; tips must stay within x105..1175 and y105..900 on the 1280x1280 reference canvas. Keep the feet exactly as they are, hooked talons curling forward/down over an invisible stone edge. Keep horn tips and face at precisely the same coordinates, no scaling or camera change. Very important directional lighting: brightly engraved fine stipple only on SCREEN-LEFT edges and wing surfaces; the screen-right face and right wing stay almost solid opaque BLACK, with only faint small edge hints. Not symmetrical lighting. Keep the torso dark, no white belly. Clean true alpha outside the dragon with at least 100px fully transparent margin on all sides. ONE complete dragon, no sheet, no neighbors, no detached flecks, no background glow/haze, no floor, no perch, no tower, no text. Preserve all other features.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the most recent SINGLE front-facing dragon into its HALF-FOLDED-WINGS landing pose. Keep EXACTLY the same camera, body size, position, horns, head, chest, hips, curved gripping claws and strong screen-left lighting. Same square canvas, transparent alpha; do not zoom or crop. Keep its feet at the same coordinates, talons hooked down over an invisible battlement, not flat. Change ONLY both wing poses: lift them halfway away from the sides, making shallow diagonal bat-wing shapes, as it folds its wings after touching down. Screen-left wing edges and upper membrane catch fine white stippled light, screen-right wing and right side of face/body remain deep opaque black with very faint rim definition. Maintain a mostly black body, no pale belly. Maximum wingspan 80 percent of the image width; 10 percent completely transparent margin on all sides; no clipping. Exactly ONE dragon, not a grid, no neighboring poses. Clean hard silhouette with natural tiny antialiasing only, no detached specks, no haze or glow or ground or labels. Preserve genuine transparency outside subject; black inside the dragon is opaque.

Use case: precise-object-edit. The reference shows six poses of a dark stippled dragon. Produce ONLY ONE isolated pose: the bottom-right PERCHED dragon, directly facing the camera, with both wings folded neatly along its body and both clawed feet curling FORWARD AND DOWN over an invisible ledge. No flat toes. Keep the same slender reptilian identity, thin horns, long snout, body proportions and fine monochrome stippling. Important lighting change: light comes ONLY from SCREEN LEFT. Left-facing edges of its left horn, cheek, wing ribs, shoulder and left talons have pale white engraving highlights; the screen-right half of the face, chest, wing and right leg remain very dark, mostly opaque black with minimal fine rim definition. No symmetrical silver highlights, bright white belly, shiny gray body, or glowing eyes. A mostly black dragon with sparse white stipple and stronger directional light. Output a SINGLE 1024x1024 PNG with genuine transparent alpha. One dragon centered x512, full figure from horn tips around y150 to talon tips around y870. Curled foot grip line y810, foot centers x390 and x635. Wings folded, so whole silhouette fits between x280 and x745. Keep at least 100px completely transparent padding on ALL four sides. Opaque black inside the subject, genuinely transparent outside and between claws. Absolutely no detached flecks, neighboring dragons, background haze, glow, shadows outside the body, frame edges, border, labels, ground or tower. Do not create a sprite sheet. One complete, centered, clean isolated dragon.

rendering: Each independent square PNG is drawn into a 512px canvas rendered at 140 scene pixels wide; offsets in _data/dragon.json register the poses. No sprite-sheet cropping.
